name: Necromancer
author: Paycei
description: Your shots stack Soul Burn on enemies, and the ones that die burning may rise as thralls that hunt for you. Shows register.status, register.thing (an allied, chasing thing), per-enemy data, mod events other mods can listen to (necromancer:raised, necromancer:raiseChance, necromancer:soulValue) and mods.export.
